theorems.name: Submission.cmcs_ss_boundary_vanish_of_disjoint
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (k + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (A : GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (B : GeometricCurrentOn U k), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1), A ω = ∫ x in S, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ θ : TestFormOn U k, B θ = ∫ x in S, ξ' x ((θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') → ∀ θ : TestFormOn U k, Disjoint (tsupport (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) S → A.boundary θ = 0 ∧ B θ = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
